# Annual Review

The year opened slowly and closed strong. Output grew in every quarter, and the teams that measured their work monthly reported the clearest gains across the whole period under review.

## Methods

Every site was visited twice, once in spring and once in autumn.

- Interviews with each team lead
- Counts of finished work
- A survey of every customer

## Results

1. Output rose by a fifth.
2. Costs held steady.
3. Waiting times fell.

### Notes on the survey

Answers came from most customers; the rest did not reply in time.

## Next Year

The plan keeps what worked and drops the rest.
